description_en: You can call the DescribeDBInstanceDetail operation to query the details of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS SQL Server实例详情
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-detail --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCziJZNwH0000 --db-instance-id rm-bp6wjk5xxxxxxxxxx --resource-group-id rg-acfmy00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceDetail

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26232.html operation to query the ID of the instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
